description: Write app-store starter files into the project for taking a Percher-hosted app to the Apple App Store / Google Play: a PWA manifest.json + service worker, a Capacitor config, and assetlinks.json / apple-app-site-association templates. Use when the user asks to 'prep my app for the app store / Play Store' or 'make it installable'. Emits starter files only — the user still owns signing, store accounts, and review; existing files are skipped unless force is set.
name: percher_appstore_kit
